bds.lede: Chinese President Xi Jinping, U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin convened for a meeting that was big on symbolism but lacking in substance.
rows: Chinese President Xi Jinping, U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin convened for a meeting that was big on symbolism but lacking in substance.
U.S. President Donald Trump is drawing criticism for elevating Vladimir Putin, whom he called a “friend,” after meetings with the Russian president and Chinese President Xi Jinping.
Trump participated on Thursday in the first-ever trilateral meeting with Putin and Xi.
Ukrainian officials fear their country's fate could be determined by agreements between Trump and Putin, raising concerns among European governments.
Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping signed a joint peace declaration at APEC in China, a historic first for the three nations' heads of state.
While the presidents have previously met for one-on-one meetings, this is their first trilateral discussion.
